A great Western dragon sweeps low over the battle, four legs tucked and wings wide, unleashing a torrent of fire across the enemy ranks.
A lone hero stands on a rise above the melee, sword raised high, rallying the wavering line as fighters surge up behind him.
A massive armored war-mammoth crashes through the front ranks, tower swaying on its back, scattering soldiers like leaves.
The king's golden banner topples as its bearer is cut down, a groan rising through the allied ranks at the terrible sight.
A giant strides into the melee, fifteen feet of scarred muscle and rage, hurling men aside with each sweep of his iron club.
A breaking line begins to rout at the eastern flank, men streaming rearward as the enemy pours through the gap like floodwater.
Two wizards duel a hundred feet above the troops, lightning and violet fire clashing between them, their shockwaves flattening soldiers below.
A griffon-rider dives screaming from the clouds, talons forward, smashing into a cluster of enemy spearmen and vanishing beneath the chaos.
A siege-tower groans, tilts, and collapses inward, crushing its own garrison as soldiers leap screaming from every level before impact.
The enemy general wheels his black destrier on a low ridge, cloak streaming, directing the assault with cold and terrible precision.
Distant reinforcements crest the northern hill in a long glittering line, their horns sounding across the valley, lifting every allied heart.
A second dragon, scaled in deep crimson, locks talons with the first in midair, both beasts roaring and tumbling above the battle.
A war-elephant draped in bronze plate charges obliquely through a pike wall, mahout screaming commands, tusks gleaming red in the firelight.
A ballista bolt the size of a young tree lances through three ranks of infantry, leaving a terrible corridor of silence.
A lone archer atop a burning gatehouse draws and looses, draws and looses, never moving even as the flames rise around her.
A shield-wall buckles at its center under a giant's assault, then steadies, men locking arms and screaming defiance back into the press.
The enemy's bone-white siege-ram splinters the gate, and through the smoking breach a tide of armored bodies begins to pour.
A cavalry captain leads a wedge of heavy horse in a thundering oblique charge, lances lowering in perfect unison at full gallop.
A sorcerer on the allied side raises both arms, calling a column of white fire from the earth that consumes an entire company.
Two champions meet between the battle lines in single combat, the armies briefly parting to witness the clash of titans.
A dragon circles a burning siege-engine, its wings fanning the flames higher, embers raining down across hundreds of upturned, terrified faces.
A young standard-bearer snatches the fallen king's banner from the mud, lifts it bleeding and shouting, and the line reforms around him.
An enemy war-giant hurls a boulder the size of a cart into the allied formation, opening a crater of carnage in an instant.
The griffon-rider, horse-sized wings beating hard, lifts the enemy's battle-standard from its bearer's hands and carries it skyward to a roar below.
From behind the allied lines, a horn-choir sounds three long notes, and the reserve infantry breaks into a full run toward the breach.
